query: SELECT managed_url_custom_hostname.sub_domain, managed_url_custom_hostname.domain_id AS "domain_id: Uuid", managed_url_custom_hostname.cloudflare_custom_hostname_id, CONCAT(workspace_domain.name, '.', workspace_domain.tld) AS "domain_name!" FROM managed_url_custom_hostname INNER JOIN workspace_domain ON managed_url_custom_hostname.domain_id = workspace_domain.id WHERE managed_url_custom_hostname.is_active = FALSE AND managed_url_custom_hostname.last_verified IS NOT NULL AND managed_url_custom_hostname.last_verified < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days';
